title: Quarterly renovation permits
text:
Renovation permits filed in the neighbourhood, third quarter.

The neighbourhood association publishes the permit list every quarter because it is public and because people ask for it. This quarter the list is short.

A permit for a rear workshop conversion was issued for 1442 Quarrystone Lane, listing a detached studio of four hundred square feet and a new electrical service. The applicant is recorded as R. Okonkwo.

Two other permits cover roof work on Live Oak and a fence replacement on Mary Street.

The association meets on the second Tuesday and the permit list is read aloud, which takes about four minutes and is the least contentious part of the evening.
